body.name: Human Body
body.description: Explore the connected regions and systems of the human body. Move closer to reveal deeper layers, or choose a structure to begin.

head.name: Head
head.description: Contains the brain and major sensory organs. The skull protects the brain.
functions: Contains the brain and major sensory organs. The skull protects the brain.

brain.name: Brain
brain.description: The brain integrates sensory information and coordinates movement, thought, memory, and many functions of the body.

frontal-lobe.name: Frontal Lobe
frontal-lobe.description: Supports planning, decision-making, and voluntary movement.
functions: Supports planning, decision-making, and voluntary movement.

parietal-lobe.name: Parietal Lobe
parietal-lobe.description: Helps integrate bodily sensation and spatial information.
functions: Helps integrate bodily sensation and spatial information.

temporal-lobe.name: Temporal Lobe
temporal-lobe.description: Contributes to hearing, language, and memory.
functions: Contributes to hearing, language, and memory.

cerebellum.name: Cerebellum
cerebellum.description: Coordinates movement and contributes to posture and balance.
functions: Coordinates movement and contributes to posture and balance.

brainstem.name: Brainstem
brainstem.description: Connects the brain with the spinal cord and supports vital functions including breathing.
functions: Connects the brain with the spinal cord and supports vital functions including breathing.

eyes.name: Eyes
eyes.description: The eyes detect light and provide sensory information for vision.
functions: The eyes detect light and provide sensory information for vision.

skull.name: Skull
skull.description: The bony framework of the head protects the brain and supports facial structures.
functions: The bony framework of the head protects the brain and supports facial structures.

chest.name: Chest
chest.description: The thorax contains the heart and lungs within a protective framework formed by the ribs and sternum.
functions: The thorax contains the heart and lungs within a protective framework formed by the ribs and sternum.

heart.name: Heart
heart.description: A muscular organ that keeps blood moving through the lungs and the rest of the body. Its four chambers work together in a coordinated pumping cycle.
functions: Supplies the body through systemic circulation

left-atrium.name: Left Atrium
left-atrium.description: Receives oxygen-rich blood returning from the lungs.
functions: Receives oxygen-rich blood returning from the lungs.

right-atrium.name: Right Atrium
right-atrium.description: Receives oxygen-poor blood returning from the body.
functions: Receives oxygen-poor blood returning from the body.

left-ventricle.name: Left Ventricle
left-ventricle.description: Pumps oxygen-rich blood into the aorta and systemic circulation.
functions: Pumps oxygen-rich blood into the aorta and systemic circulation.

right-ventricle.name: Right Ventricle
right-ventricle.description: Pumps blood into the pulmonary circulation toward the lungs.
functions: Pumps blood into the pulmonary circulation toward the lungs.

aorta.name: Aorta
aorta.description: The main artery carrying blood from the left ventricle to the body.
functions: The main artery carrying blood from the left ventricle to the body.

pulmonary-artery.name: Pulmonary Artery
pulmonary-artery.description: Carries oxygen-poor blood from the right ventricle toward the lungs.
functions: Carries oxygen-poor blood from the right ventricle toward the lungs.

pulmonary-veins.name: Pulmonary Veins
pulmonary-veins.description: Return oxygen-rich blood from the lungs to the left atrium.
functions: Return oxygen-rich blood from the lungs to the left atrium.

valves.name: Valves
valves.description: The tricuspid, pulmonary, mitral, and aortic valves guide one-way blood flow through the heart.
functions: The tricuspid, pulmonary, mitral, and aortic valves guide one-way blood flow through the heart.

left-lung.name: Left Lung
left-lung.description: Exchanges oxygen and carbon dioxide between inhaled air and the blood. The left lung has two lobes.
functions: Exchanges oxygen and carbon dioxide between inhaled air and the blood. The left lung has two lobes.

right-lung.name: Right Lung
right-lung.description: Exchanges gases through its branching airways and alveoli. The right lung has three lobes.
functions: Exchanges gases through its branching airways and alveoli. The right lung has three lobes.

rib-cage.name: Rib Cage
rib-cage.description: Ribs, thoracic vertebrae, and the sternum form a protective cage around the heart and lungs.
functions: Ribs, thoracic vertebrae, and the sternum form a protective cage around the heart and lungs.

abdomen.name: Abdomen
abdomen.description: Contains much of the digestive system and organs involved in processing nutrients and removing waste.
functions: Contains much of the digestive system and organs involved in processing nutrients and removing waste.

liver.name: Liver
liver.description: Processes absorbed nutrients, produces bile, and performs many metabolic functions.
functions: Processes absorbed nutrients, produces bile, and performs many metabolic functions.

stomach.name: Stomach
stomach.description: Stores and mixes food with gastric secretions as part of digestion.
functions: Stores and mixes food with gastric secretions as part of digestion.

kidneys.name: Kidneys
kidneys.description: Filter blood and help regulate fluid, electrolytes, and acid-base balance.
functions: Filter blood and help regulate fluid, electrolytes, and acid-base balance.

intestines.name: Intestines
intestines.description: The small intestine absorbs most nutrients. The large intestine absorbs water and forms stool.
functions: The small intestine absorbs most nutrients. The large intestine absorbs water and forms stool.

arms.name: Arms
arms.description: The upper limbs support reaching, positioning, and manipulation.
functions: The upper limbs support reaching, positioning, and manipulation.

left-arm.name: Left Arm
left-arm.description: The arm and forearm connect the shoulder to the hand.
functions: The arm and forearm connect the shoulder to the hand.

upper-arm.name: Left Upper Arm
upper-arm.description: The humerus provides the bony framework between shoulder and elbow.
functions: The humerus provides the bony framework between shoulder and elbow.

forearm.name: Left Forearm
forearm.description: The radius and ulna support forearm rotation and the wrist.
functions: The radius and ulna support forearm rotation and the wrist.

hand.name: Left Hand
hand.description: The hand combines bones, joints, muscles, tendons, nerves, and vessels for precise movement and touch.
functions: The hand combines bones, joints, muscles, tendons, nerves, and vessels for precise movement and touch.

right-arm.name: Right Arm
right-arm.description: The arm and forearm connect the shoulder to the hand.
functions: The arm and forearm connect the shoulder to the hand.

right-upper-arm.name: Right Upper Arm
right-upper-arm.description: The humerus provides the bony framework between shoulder and elbow.
functions: The humerus provides the bony framework between shoulder and elbow.

right-forearm.name: Right Forearm
right-forearm.description: The radius and ulna support forearm rotation and the wrist.
functions: The radius and ulna support forearm rotation and the wrist.

right-hand.name: Right Hand
right-hand.description: The hand combines bones, joints, muscles, tendons, nerves, and vessels for precise movement and touch.
functions: The hand combines bones, joints, muscles, tendons, nerves, and vessels for precise movement and touch.

hand-bones.name: Bones
hand-bones.description: The hand contains carpals, metacarpals, and phalanges.
functions: The hand contains carpals, metacarpals, and phalanges.

carpals.name: Carpals
carpals.description: Eight wrist bones connect the forearm and hand.
functions: Eight wrist bones connect the forearm and hand.

metacarpals.name: Metacarpals
metacarpals.description: Five bones form the framework of the palm.
functions: Five bones form the framework of the palm.

phalanges.name: Phalanges
phalanges.description: Fourteen bones form the fingers and thumb.
functions: Fourteen bones form the fingers and thumb.

hand-muscles.name: Muscles
hand-muscles.description: Muscles in the hand and forearm cooperate to move the digits.
functions: Muscles in the hand and forearm cooperate to move the digits.

hand-tendons.name: Tendons
hand-tendons.description: Connect muscles to bones and transmit force for movement.
functions: Connect muscles to bones and transmit force for movement.

hand-nerves.name: Nerves
hand-nerves.description: Carry sensory information and signals that activate muscles.
functions: Carry sensory information and signals that activate muscles.

hand-vessels.name: Blood Vessels
hand-vessels.description: Supply hand tissues and return blood toward the heart.
functions: Supply hand tissues and return blood toward the heart.

legs.name: Legs
legs.description: The lower limbs support body weight and enable standing and locomotion.
functions: The lower limbs support body weight and enable standing and locomotion.

left-leg.name: Left Leg
left-leg.description: Explore the thigh, knee, lower leg, and foot as a connected lower limb.

femur.name: Femur — left
femur.description: Thigh bone connecting the hip region with the knee.

knee.name: Knee

tibia.name: Tibia — left
tibia.description: The larger lower-leg bone bears most of the transmitted body weight.

fibula.name: Fibula — left
fibula.description: Slender bone alongside the tibia on the outer side of the lower leg.
functions: Slender bone alongside the tibia on the outer side of the lower leg.

foot.name: Foot
foot.description: A structure of bones, joints, and soft tissues that supports balance and movement.
functions: A structure of bones, joints, and soft tissues that supports balance and movement.

right-tibia.description: The larger lower-leg bone bears most of the transmitted body weight.

right-fibula.description: Slender bone alongside the tibia on the outer side of the lower leg.

right-foot.name: Foot
right-foot.description: A structure of bones, joints, and soft tissues that supports balance and movement.
functions: A structure of bones, joints, and soft tissues that supports balance and movement.

leg-muscles.name: Muscles
leg-muscles.description: Generate force to support posture and move the lower limb.

leg-nerves.name: Nerves
leg-nerves.description: Carry motor and sensory signals between the lower limb and central nervous system.
